_note: Register: everyday standard Hausa, second person familiar (ka/ki mixed as context requires, defaulting masculine where a single form is needed, matching the pack's own convention) rather than the polite plural ku, since this is software chrome addressed to one user directly. Bare imperative verb stems on buttons (Fitarwa, Ajiye, Soke, Rufe) the way Hausa software UI conventionally does. Terms of art: a printed face is fuska and a sheet is takarda, so "faces/sheets" is fuska/takarda; duplex is ɓangarori biyu (two sides); typeface is nau'in rubutu; romanisation is rubutun Roman; the respelling field is Yadda ake fadinsa and the literal gloss Ainihin ma'ana; "glossed into" is An fassara zuwa. Romanisation systems keep their Latin/English names (ALA-LC, BGN/PCGN, ELOT 743, Hepburn, Hunterian, IAST, Kunrei-shiki, McCune-Reischauer, Okrand, Pinyin, RTGS) since Hausa has no settled calque for any of them, except roman.appendix-e and roman.rr, translated the way Indonesian's own catalogue translates the same two. Interpolation: Intl.DisplayNames hands Hausa a real language name already (Turanci, Larabci, Sinanci), not a bare ethnonym the way it hands Indonesian one, because the -anci/-nci suffix already means "language of" -- confirmed directly (Intl.DisplayNames(['ha']).of('ar') gives larabci, not just 'Larabawa') -- so no head-noun fix is needed on the {language} templates the way Indonesian's bahasa- prefix was. Interface-strings wave: a UI button is maɓalli / maɓallai (ha.wikipedia, Fasahar Maɗannin komfuta), not mabuɗi, which this file already spends on the pronunciation legend. Delete is Goge and remove-from-one-screen is Cire, leaving Share for clearing a list the way studio.balanceBlocked uses it; Settings is Saituttuka and browser is burauza, both taken from ha.wikipedia's own pages. Screen is allo / alluna, device na'ura, copy kwafi, voice murya. Confirmation prompts use the impersonal a rather than the ka the rest of the file addresses the reader with, so a deletion question does not sex the reader; explanatory prose keeps ka. komai, not kome. Hooked letters are written hooked -- buƙata, ƙarami, ɓangare, kuɗi, ƙasa, ƙafa -- and data/lang/ha/*.csv plus several older keys here still write them bare, which is a defect and not a house style. Interface-strings wave (studio, export, preview), printing terms: a tab stays Tab, the way this file already writes it at format.headSpan, because Hausa stationery has no name for the coloured projection on the edge of a card -- so that spelling is open to revision, not settled. Band and strip are ratsi (ha.wikipedia, Rawan dumi, "ratsi masu launi"); corner kusurwa, edge gefe, margin iyaka, each the word this file already spends on the same thing. "Rail" became a ratsi running down the outside and "fanned stack" became "tarin katunan ... idan an baje su kamar fanka", since Hausa has no trade term for either. format.headSlot.theme is Jigo, the word board.pickTopic already uses, because the slot prints the face's colour-group title rather than the name of the visual theme. .zip is written "fayil na ZIP" so a leading dot does not stand alone. gallery.tagline renders the product name Wanderwart as katunan jimla, which is what gallery.docTitle calls it, and "tab your way through" as taɓa maɓalli. preview.lockDate and preview.lockTime are left out on purpose: they come from CLDR. format.theme.parchment has no attested Hausa word or loan for parchment as a writing material, so it is worded descriptively as Takarda ta gargajiya (paper of tradition/classic-style paper), reusing gargajiya from ornament.classic rather than coining a fata+rubutu compound. Number pass (this round): drill.pool, studio.imported and editor.imported glued the raw count to a plural noun (layuka, gyare-gyare, sabbin abubuwa, maɓallai, alluna), wrong at count=1; rewritten as a generic-plural label before a colon, the device personal.loaded already uses. warn.no-fit.auto paired the singular noun fuska with the plural future marker "za su"; changed to the singular "za ta" to agree with the invariant singular the file already keeps after a numeral. fix.dropSections is new. Most-used and speak-on-tap wave (26 keys): the mode is “Karanta da murya idan an taɓa”, board.speak's own words plus the taɓa of about.unset and beacon.dismiss; display.tapSpeaks opens with the same words, and display.tapNoVoice quotes it as its subject and names the language with check.voice's muryar {language}. The screen is “Waɗanda aka fi amfani da su” (the fi comparative, 'the ones used most'), quoted after allon in prose. Press is danna, as in board.arrangeHint. The file has no word for a grid (format.arrangementTitle.mixed says tsari), so 'the grid stays' became 'the buttons stay where they are'. Counts are adadin dannawa and reset is Share, the file's own verb for clearing; usage.resetBody drops the second-person possessive so the confirmation dialog does not sex the reader, as the prompts already avoid. usage.window is the noun Tsawon lokaci, since the options are also the counts table's column headings; the windows are counted in days and months (Kwana 7 da suka wuce, not the calendar week), and usage.all is Tun farko. usage.scopeOne is Don {language} kaɗai, 'for English only', because a bare {language} after Ƙirga reads as counting in that language.

check.contextsGaps: Jigogi: {contexts}. Maɓallai: {buttons}. Waɗanda ba a rubuta ba tukuna a cikin waɗannan harsuna: {gaps} — an nuna su a shuɗe.
check.writing: Rubutun {language} yana bayyana a wannan na'urar
check.writingDetail: Haruffa: {count}, waɗanda allunan ke amfani da su — duk za a iya zana su a nan.
check.writingMissing: Haruffa: {count} suna bayyana kamar akwatin fanko a nan: {letters}. Sabunta wayar, ko ƙara nau'in rubutu don wannan rubutun.
check.sayItGaps: Akwai furuci ga jimloli: {count} daga cikin {total}; sauran suna nuna kalmomi kaɗai.
check.voiceHere: A wannan na'urar: tana magana ba tare da haɗin yanar gizo ba.
check.voiceOnline: Sai da haɗin yanar gizo kawai. Kalmomin za su ci gaba da bayyana ko da babu haɗi.
check.voiceUnknown: An samu ta, amma wannan na'urar ba ta bayyana ko tana aiki ba tare da yanar gizo ba. Gwada Karanta da murya sau ɗaya yayin da haɗin ya kashe.
check.voiceNone: Babu ita a wannan na'urar. Kalmomin za su ci gaba da bayyana; ƙara murya don wannan harshen a saitunan magana na wayar don jin su.
check.savedDetail: An ajiye fayiloli: {count}, duk a nan, don amfani ba tare da yanar gizo ba.
check.unsaved: Fayiloli: {count} ba a ajiye su a wannan na'urar tukuna ba.
check.noWorker: Wannan burauzar ba ta ajiye komai don amfani ba tare da yanar gizo ba. Buɗe wannan sau ɗaya kuma tare da haɗi, ko a shigar da shi.
check.bundled: Wani bangare ne na wannan: babu abin sauke.
arrange.removeWhy: Maɓallin allon kansa za a iya sake kunna shi a Gyara maɓallai; naka kaɗai ake cire daga wannan allon.
arrange.removeWhyContexts: Jigon manhajar kansa za a iya sake kunna shi a cikin Saituttuka a nan; naka kaɗai ake cire daga jerin.
display.askRemove: Tambaya kafin sake tsarawa ta cire maɓalli daga allo
display.tapSpeaks: Karanta da murya idan an taɓa: maɓallin yana faɗin jimlarsa, maɓallan kuma suna nan a wurinsu
display.tapNoVoice: “Karanta da murya idan an taɓa” yana buƙatar muryar {language} a wannan na'urar.
boards.mostUsed.title: Waɗanda aka fi amfani da su
mostUsed.empty: Maɓallan da ka fi dannawa suna taruwa a nan, daga dukan jigogi.
usage.lede: Allon “Waɗanda aka fi amfani da su” yana nuna maɓallan da ka fi dannawa da farko. Ana ƙirga su a wannan na'urar kaɗai.
usage.none: Ba ka danna wani maɓalli ba tukuna.
usage.resetBody: Za a goge duk adadin dannawar kowane maɓalli daga wannan na'urar, kuma allon “Waɗanda aka fi amfani da su” zai sake farawa babu komai a ciki. Maɓallai da saituttuka za su zauna yadda suke.
